message.content:
I see. So `mg_http_parse` with my data:
- `req_len = mg_http_get_request_len(buf, len)` - finds end of headers at `\r\n\r\n`.
- `hm->body.len = ~0` initially.
- No Content-Length header, so `body.len` stays `~0`.
- `is_response = false` (method is GET).
- `body.len == ~0 && !is_response && method != PUT && method != POST` - true, so `body.len = 0`, `message.len = req_len`.

So `mg_http_parse` returns `req_len` (positive). Good.

Now in `http_cb`, `mg_is_chunked(&hm)` checks for `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`. Let me verify this header is parsed correctly.

Let me check `mg_http_parse_headers` to see if `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` is parsed correctly.
